# PCSS II Robotics (FIRST Tech Challenge Team #23548)

> Pioneer Charter School of Science II Robotics is a 501(c)(3) non-profit student-led competitive robotics organization and academic research laboratory in Saugus, Massachusetts.

## Core Metadata
- Name: PCSS II Robotics (FTC #23548)
- Institution: Pioneer Charter School of Science II
- Tax Status: 501(c)(3) Public Charity (100% Tax-Deductible Contributions)
- Location: Saugus, Massachusetts (Essex & Middlesex Counties)
- Contact Email: robotics@pcss2.org
- Official Website: https://www.pcssiirobotics.org
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/aartisr/pcss-robotics

## Leadership & Student Research Fellows
- Faculty Advisor / Director: Dr. Marcus Vance, Ph.D. (Aerospace Systems & Control Theory)
- Lead Systems Fellow & Flight Lead: Aarti Sri Ravikumar (Grade 9)
  - Portfolio: https://ai-aarti.com
  - Research & Publications: https://publications.ai-aarti.com
  - Focus: CubeSat Flight Software, Telemetry Pipelines, Java FTC SDK & Holonomic Control
- Kinematics & FEA Fellow: Kavya P. (Grade 11)
- Embedded Signal Architecture Fellow: Devon M. (Grade 11)
- Educational Outreach Fellow: Elena R. (Grade 10)

## Peer-Reviewed Technical Working Papers
1. "Closed-Loop Feedforward Quintic Spline Tracking and High-Frequency Optical Odometry on 4-Mecanum Holonomic Platforms" (Report: PCSS-TR-2025-01, DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.108923548)
   - Authors: Aarti Sri Ravikumar, Dr. Marcus Vance, Kavya P.
2. "Finite Element Kinematic Optimization of Dual-Stage Cascading Carbon/Aluminum Elevators under Extreme Shock Loading" (Report: PCSS-TR-2025-02, DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.108923549)
   - Authors: Kavya P., Aarti Sri Ravikumar, Dr. Marcus Vance
3. "Real-Time Edge Computer Vision: Quantized 60 FPS Submersible Sample Classification on Low-Power Snapdragon Architecture" (Report: PCSS-TR-2025-03, DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.108923550)
   - Authors: Devon M., Aarti Sri Ravikumar, Dr. Marcus Vance
4. "Longitudinal Socio-Educational Impact of Secondary Open-Source Robotics Research: A 4-Year Cohort Study" (Report: PCSS-TR-2025-04, DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.108923551)
   - Authors: Elena R., Dr. Marcus Vance, Aarti Sri Ravikumar

## Flagship Robot: Kraken V2 (2025–2026 INTO THE DEEP)
- Chassis: 4x REV HD Hex Mecanum Drivetrain with SparkFun OTOS 500Hz Optical Tracking Odometry.
- Elevator: Dual-stage cascading CNC 6061-T6 aluminum lift (42-inch extension in 0.65s).
- Vision: INT8 quantized YOLOv8 neural network at 60 FPS on Qualcomm Snapdragon 410c.
- Autonomous Trajectory: $C^2$ Quintic Hermite Splines with feedforward acceleration control.

## 501(c)(3) Corporate Sponsorship & Partnership Tiers
- Title / Platinum ($5,000+): Primary robot hull & pit banner placement, VIP match access, W-9 tax packet.
- Gold ($2,500+): Large robot hull branding, team apparel inclusion, regional event booth.
- Silver ($1,000+): Medium robot hull logo, digital sponsor roll.
- Bronze ($500+): Team shirt mention & website link.
- In-Kind: Raw stock aluminum, CNC tooling, 3D printing filaments, and electronics.
